story: At 6:17 on a sunny Sunday evening in Sumter Oaks, Gary and Donna are wrapping up a dance coaching session at the Rec Center, with Gary grateful for the lessons and Donna cheerful about his footwork. Over on Magnolia Loop, Hal is feeling remorseful as he heads to Rosa's House, while Rosa, who has accepted his apology, is relieved and getting the table ready. Everyone seems to be heading toward a happy Sunday supper at Rosa's.

gary.thought_process: Donna just coached me on footwork and mentioned dinner at Rosa's, and it's already 6:17. Rosa's roast has been waiting on me all afternoon and I don't want to let anyone down again. I don't need to repeat my earlier agreement; I should respond to her encouragement, wrap up this rally, and steer us toward Rosa's. Being useful and showing up for people matters to me, and Donna's been good to me.

parameters.content: Thanks for the coaching, Donna, my knees may never forgive you but my footwork says thank you. Let's call it here so we can get over to Rosa's by six-thirty before that roast goes cold on me again.

donna.thought_process: Gary and I have been rallying for a while and he's looking steady on his footwork. The ladder sheet already says Pruitt-Kowalski, and I promised dinner at Rosa's at six, which is already behind us if anything, so I should wrap this up and keep things moving. One last bit of encouragement, then suggest we head to dinner rather than repeating my earlier lines about footwork.

parameters.content: That's a wrap for today, Gary, you're moving like a pro out there. Let's pack up and get over to Rosa's before the Sunday crowd takes all the good tables.

hal.thought_process: Rosa just told me dinner's been waiting since five and my chair is empty. I already apologized last tick and promised to be at her table on time, and I'm already late. Repeating the apology would be pointless. The complaint file on Gary's cart and Donna's flamingos can wait until after pork. Time to stop talking and go. Rosa's house is connected to Magnolia Loop.

parameters.content: Heading to Rosa's for dinner, as promised. Complaint file can wait until after the pork.

rosa.thought_process: Hal just apologized and promised to be at my table tonight, on time. I already asked him once, so I shouldn't repeat the invitation. Gary and Donna are still missing, and that's the real obstacle to my goal of getting all three neighbors at one table. Hal can help: he's right here and knows the neighborhood. I'll accept his apology warmly and ask him to nudge Gary and Donna, since two voices are better than one. Then I can go check on them myself.

parameters.content: Thank you, Hal, apology accepted. If you see Gary or Donna on your way, tell them the table's set and there's no lecture waiting. I'll go knock on a door or two myself.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
